# Abysslink

> Abysslink is an open-source (Apache-2.0) Go CLI and optional daemon that turn a macOS or
> Linux laptop into a hardened, phone-controlled dev rig: private mesh VPN (Tailscale, or
> self-hosted Headscale/NetBird), hardened SSH, tmux + mosh session persistence, and
> self-hosted push notifications whose bodies never touch third-party servers. It is built
> for supervising AI coding agents (Claude Code, Aider, Codex, or any CLI agent) from a
> phone: get a push the moment the agent needs input, tap into the live tmux session,
> approve or deny risky actions, or kill the run outright. Dry-run is the default for every
> mutating command; every file change is backed up and written to a tamper-evident,
> HMAC-chained audit log; `abysslink uninstall` reverses everything. Zero telemetry,
> enforced by CI.

Key facts:
- Current stable line: v4.x (semver; security fixes on the latest minor).
- Platforms: macOS 13+ and Linux (amd64/arm64). No Windows.
- Requires: disk encryption (FileVault/LUKS — the doctor command fails closed without it)
  and a Tailscale account or self-hosted control plane.
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abysslink/abysslink/main/install.sh | sh`
  or `brew install --cask abysslink/tap/abysslink`. Releases are cosign-signed with
  SLSA Build L3 provenance.
- Not affiliated with Anthropic; "Claude Code" integration is one opt-in module of a
  generic, agent-agnostic notify/watch core.

## Docs

- [Documentation home](https://abysslink.dev/docs/): overview and orientation
- [Quickstart](https://abysslink.dev/docs/quickstart/): install to phone-paired in ~5-8 minutes
- [CLI reference](https://abysslink.dev/docs/cli-reference/): every command and flag
- [Configuration](https://abysslink.dev/docs/configuration/): full abysslink.yaml schema
- [Security & threat model](https://abysslink.dev/docs/security/): defenses, non-goals, hardening
- [Agent safety](https://abysslink.dev/docs/agent-safety/): kill-switch, approve loop, quorum gate, dead-man switch
- [Who sees what](https://abysslink.dev/docs/who-sees-what/): per-push-path data visibility
- [FAQ](https://abysslink.dev/docs/operations/faq/)
- [Uninstall](https://abysslink.dev/docs/operations/uninstall/)
